question: Across all Chicago wards, compute the Pearson correlation coefficient between the ward-level food inspection failure rate and the ward-level crime arrest rate.

turn1_sqls.sql: SELECT ward_no, AVG(CASE WHEN arrest = 'TRUE' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS arrest_rate FROM Crime WHERE ward_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ward_no

question: To examine how harsh weather relates to domestic violence in Chicago, compute the Welch's t-statistic and p-value comparing monthly domestic violence crime rates between harsh and non-harsh months. Return the result as {"t": <float>, "p": <float>}

turn1_sqls.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, AVG(preciptotal) AS avg_precip FROM weather GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)

SELECT substr(trim(substr(date, instr(date,'/')+1)), instr(trim(substr(date, instr(date,'/')+1)),'/')+1, 4) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(substr(date, 1, instr(date,'/')-1) AS INTEGER)) AS month, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN domestic='TRUE' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/COUNT(*) AS dv_rate FROM Crime GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

details.gold_sql: SELECT yr_month, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_precip FROM (SELECT station_nbr, SUBSTR(date, 1, 7) AS yr_month, AVG(preciptotal) AS station_avg FROM weather WHERE preciptotal IS NOT NULL GROUP BY station_nbr, SUBSTR(date, 1, 7)) GROUP BY yr_month

question: To examine whether age groups with higher self-reported mental health burden incur greater medical costs, run a gender-stratified Welch's t-test comparing total claim amounts per patient between high-burden and low-burden age groups within each gender. Return the result as {"female_t": <float>, "female_p": <float>, "male_t": <float>, "male_p": <float>}.

turn1_sqls.sql: SELECT gender_ans.AnswerText AS gender, CASE WHEN CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34' WHEN CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49' WHEN CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65' END AS age_group, COUNT(*) AS total_respondents, SUM(CASE WHEN mh_ans.AnswerText = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_count, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN mh_ans.AnswerText = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS burden_rate FROM Answer age_ans JOIN Answer gender_ans ON age_ans.UserID = gender_ans.UserID JOIN Answer mh_ans ON age_ans.UserID = mh_ans.UserID WHERE age_ans.QuestionID = 1 AND gender_ans.QuestionID = 2 AND mh_ans.QuestionID IN (SELECT questionid FROM Question WHERE LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%mental health%' AND LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%yes%') AND gender_ans.AnswerText IN ('Male', 'Female') AND CAST(age_ans.AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 65 GROUP BY gender_ans.AnswerText, age_group HAVING age_group IS NOT NULL

SELECT q.questionid, q.questiontext, a.AnswerText, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Question q JOIN Answer a ON q.questionid = a.QuestionID WHERE a.AnswerText IN ('Yes','No','Maybe') GROUP BY q.questionid, q.questiontext, a.AnswerText ORDER BY q.questionid, cnt DESC

WITH age_ans AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(AnswerText AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Answer WHERE QuestionID = 1), gender_ans AS (SELECT UserID, AnswerText AS gender FROM Answer WHERE QuestionID = 2 AND AnswerText IN ('Male','Female')), mh_qs AS (SELECT DISTINCT QuestionID FROM Answer WHERE AnswerText = 'Yes' AND QuestionID NOT IN (1,2,3)), yes_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.UserID FROM Answer a WHERE a.AnswerText = 'Yes' AND a.QuestionID IN (SELECT QuestionID FROM mh_qs)), base AS (SELECT g.UserID, g.gender, CASE WHEN aa.age BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34' WHEN aa.age BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49' WHEN aa.age BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65' END AS age_group FROM gender_ans g JOIN age_ans aa ON g.UserID = aa.UserID WHERE aa.age BETWEEN 18 AND 65) SELECT b.gender, b.age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserID) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN y.UserID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_count, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN y.UserID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserID) AS burden_rate FROM base b LEFT JOIN yes_users y ON b.UserID = y.UserID WHERE b.age_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.gender, b.age_group ORDER BY b.gender, b.age_group

WITH age_q AS (SELECT 1 AS qid), gender_q AS (SELECT 2 AS qid), mh_burden_q AS (SELECT questionid FROM Question WHERE LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%mental health%' AND (LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%interfer%' OR LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%treatment%' OR LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%sought%' OR LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%sought%' OR LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%diagnos%')), ages AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(AnswerText AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Answer WHERE QuestionID = 1 AND CAST(AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 65), genders AS (SELECT UserID, AnswerText AS gender FROM Answer WHERE QuestionID = 2 AND AnswerText IN ('Male','Female')), mh_yes AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM Answer WHERE QuestionID IN (SELECT questionid FROM mh_burden_q) AND AnswerText = 'Yes'), combined AS (SELECT a.UserID, g.gender, CASE WHEN a.age BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34' WHEN a.age BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49' WHEN a.age BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65' END AS age_group FROM ages a JOIN genders g ON a.UserID = g.UserID) SELECT c.gender, c.age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserID) AS total_respondents, SUM(CASE WHEN m.UserID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_count, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.UserID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserID) AS burden_rate FROM combined c LEFT JOIN mh_yes m ON c.UserID = m.UserID WHERE c.age_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.gender, c.age_group ORDER BY c.gender, c.age_group

WITH ages AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(AnswerText AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Answer WHERE QuestionID = 1 AND CAST(AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 65), genders AS (SELECT UserID, AnswerText AS gender FROM Answer WHERE QuestionID = 2 AND AnswerText IN ('Male','Female')), mh_yes AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM Answer WHERE AnswerText = 'Yes'), combined AS (SELECT a.UserID, g.gender, CASE WHEN a.age BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34' WHEN a.age BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49' WHEN a.age BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65' END AS age_group FROM ages a JOIN genders g ON a.UserID = g.UserID) SELECT c.gender, c.age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserID) AS total_respondents, SUM(CASE WHEN m.UserID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_count, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.UserID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserID) AS burden_rate FROM combined c LEFT JOIN mh_yes m ON c.UserID = m.UserID WHERE c.age_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.gender, c.age_group ORDER BY c.gender, c.age_group

WITH patient_ages AS (SELECT patient, gender, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birthdate) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM patients WHERE deathdate IS NULL AND gender IN ('M','F')), patient_age_groups AS (SELECT patient, gender, CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34' WHEN age BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49' WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65' END AS age_group FROM patient_ages WHERE age BETWEEN 18 AND 65), patient_claims AS (SELECT PATIENT, SUM(TOTAL) AS total_claims FROM claims GROUP BY PATIENT) SELECT pag.gender, pag.age_group, pag.patient, COALESCE(pc.total_claims, 0) AS total_claims FROM patient_age_groups pag LEFT JOIN patient_claims pc ON pag.patient = pc.PATIENT WHERE pag.age_group IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pag.gender, pag.age_group

WITH patient_ages AS (SELECT patient, gender, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birthdate) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM patients WHERE deathdate IS NULL AND gender IN ('M','F')), patient_age_groups AS (SELECT patient, gender, CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34' WHEN age BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49' WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65' END AS age_group FROM patient_ages WHERE age BETWEEN 18 AND 65), patient_claims AS (SELECT PATIENT, SUM(TOTAL) AS total_claims FROM claims GROUP BY PATIENT) SELECT pag.gender, pag.age_group, COUNT(pag.patient) AS n, AVG(COALESCE(pc.total_claims, 0)) AS mean_claims, SUM(COALESCE(pc.total_claims, 0) * COALESCE(pc.total_claims, 0)) AS sum_sq, SUM(COALESCE(pc.total_claims, 0)) AS sum_claims FROM patient_age_groups pag LEFT JOIN patient_claims pc ON pag.patient = pc.PATIENT WHERE pag.age_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pag.gender, pag.age_group ORDER BY pag.gender, pag.age_group

execution_results.sql: WITH age_q AS (SELECT 1 AS qid), gender_q AS (SELECT 2 AS qid), mh_burden_q AS (SELECT questionid FROM Question WHERE LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%mental health%' AND (LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%interfer%' OR LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%treatment%' OR LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%sought%' OR LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%sought%' OR LOWER(questiontext) LIKE '%diagnos%')), ages AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(AnswerText AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Answer WHERE QuestionID = 1 AND CAST(AnswerText AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 65), genders AS (SELECT UserID, AnswerText AS gender FROM Answer WHERE QuestionID = 2 AND AnswerText IN ('Male','Female')), mh_yes AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM Answer WHERE QuestionID IN (SELECT questionid FROM mh_burden_q) AND AnswerText = 'Yes'), combined AS (SELECT a.UserID, g.gender, CASE WHEN a.age BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34' WHEN a.age BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49' WHEN a.age BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65' END AS age_group FROM ages a JOIN genders g ON a.UserID = g.UserID) SELECT c.gender, c.age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserID) AS total_respondents, SUM(CASE WHEN m.UserID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_count, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.UserID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserID) AS burden_rate FROM combined c LEFT JOIN mh_yes m ON c.UserID = m.UserID WHERE c.age_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.gender, c.age_group ORDER BY c.gender, c.age_group

So how do we fix this? (and this answer will be based on my experiences)

1 - Physical health is important. If your body is not well, your mind will not be as well. A healthy diet and sports should be a part of every company incentives for a healthy life.

2 - Burnout: A stressed software engineer will surely burn out quickly. Stress sources can come from many places, but most of them come from work demand with unreasonable deadlines. If a developer is working more than 40 hours a week on a constant basis, burning out is just a matter of time. Knowing that burnout/stress is an issue, the employee and the company MUST address it properly.

3 - Culture: This one speaks to me personally. One of the issues that I had the most were environments where there is a poisonous culture generated by the development team. Improper leadership and cliques just add to a bad culture and that will lead to stress. Unfortunately, there is no easy fix for this. If the culture of the company is bad you are better of leaving.

4 - Clear expectations: Once an issue has been identified and treatment is in progress it is important that both the company and the employee have clear expectations.     SELECT

    FROM combined
)
